name: Line or word reveal
prompt: Split the headline into lines with masks; each line slides up from below its mask with a 0.08 s stagger when 70 % in view. Run once.

name: Character fade-in
prompt: Split into characters and fade opacity only, in order or shuffled, scrubbed to the first half of the section. No movement, so it suits calm brands.

name: Cinematic title
prompt: Large title lines enter alternately from left and right with a long expo ease, like film credits. Lines, words or chars, each with its own stagger.

name: Popping letters
prompt: Characters scale from 0 with a small random rotation and a back-out bounce, origin top-left. For playful one-line statements only.

name: 3D folding letters
prompt: Characters rotate in on the X axis from 90 degrees with perspective on the parent, scrubbed to scroll. Keep to one headline.

name: Text scramble
prompt: Characters cycle through a charset (A-Z, 0-9, binary) and lock in left to right. Trigger on view, hover or click. Real text in an aria-label.

name: Two-colour scramble
prompt: Scramble first in the accent colour, then settle into the text colour. Stack the final text under the scramble span so the layout never shifts.

name: Typewriter
prompt: Type a phrase character by character, pause, delete, type the next. Timeline only, no intervals. Caret blinks with CSS. Stop after one cycle when reduced motion is on.

name: Shimmer wave
prompt: A highlight travels across the characters as a wave of brightness and slight lift. Loop slowly or once on view.

name: Fill on scroll
prompt: Big headline starts as outline or muted colour and fills line by line with scroll; an accent band rides the edge of the fill.

name: Word focus brackets
prompt: Four corner brackets move from word to word and resize to each; the framed word stays sharp, the rest blur slightly. Scroll or hover drives it.

name: Word wheel
prompt: Words on a vertical wheel with 3D rotateX; the centre word is full opacity, the others fade with distance. Scroll-driven or autoplay that lands on the last word.

name: Rolling first word
prompt: One word in a sentence rolls through a looping list as you scroll while the rest of the sentence stays still; the active word gets the accent.

name: Typed text morph
prompt: As the user types, letters that shift position glide to their new place with Flip. For search fields and live headlines.

name: Velocity type
prompt: Variable font axes (weight, width, slant) follow scroll velocity, then ease back to rest. Needs a variable font; clamp the range so text stays readable.

name: Echo headline
prompt: One word with stacked copies behind it in 3D that spread out with scroll and fade with depth. Copies are aria-hidden.

name: Crossover text
prompt: A big headline changes colour exactly where images pass under it, using a duplicated layer clipped to the image bounds.

name: Text on a hidden path
prompt: Words appear one by one along an invisible SVG curve as you scroll; only the words show the line.

name: Parting text
prompt: A fixed image in the centre while manifesto lines scroll past; each line splits around the image and closes after it.

name: Editorial indent
prompt: Lines rise from masks, then the first line slides right to open an indent and a small image fades into the gap.

name: Zoom through text
prompt: A big word scales up with scroll until the camera passes between two letters into the next section. Pin the section; give a skip link.

name: Images inside a headline
prompt: Small photos sit between words; on view the lines rise and the photo slots widen, pushing words apart.

name: Block wipe text
prompt: Each line is covered by a rounded block that shrinks to zero width while the text slides in behind it.

name: Scribble highlight
prompt: A hand-drawn circle or underline draws around one key word when the headline enters. One word per page.

name: Split-flap board
prompt: Tiles flip through characters like a station board, rows cascading left to right, each tile landing on its own beat. For scores, times, launches.

name: Directional underline
prompt: Underline grows from the left on hover and leaves to the right on exit. The default link hover for most sites.

name: Text split by image
prompt: An image grows from zero between two halves of a headline and pushes them apart; scrub or on enter. Hero only.

name: Scroll reveal set
prompt: One utility with six reveals: fade, slide up, scale, clip, blur, rotate, with stagger for grids. The base layer of every site; run once, 400 to 700 ms.

name: Parallax layers
prompt: Layers move at different speeds (background 0.8, foreground 1.1). Keep the difference small; disable on reduced motion.

name: Section colour change
prompt: Page background and text colours tween as zones enter, instead of hard section breaks. Check contrast at every step.

name: Reading progress
prompt: Ring with percentage, thin bar, or text counter for long pages and articles.

name: Hide-on-scroll header
prompt: Header hides when scrolling down past a threshold, shows on scroll up and always shows near the top and when focus is inside it.

name: Stacking cards
prompt: Pinned frame; each new card slides up over the last, which scales back, tilts and dims; a small counter jumps to any card. Text arrives after its card settles.

name: Tilted panel stands up
prompt: An image lies tilted back under the headline and rotates upright to fill the grid as you scroll; headline lifts away.

name: Media breaks out
prompt: A video band sits in the grid beside copy, then grows to full bleed with scroll. For showreels and case study intros.

name: Capsule hero
prompt: Two giant letters part to reveal a video in a rounded capsule; click expands it to full screen and back.

name: Shape mask reveal
prompt: Content opens through a growing circle, oval, blob or image mask (clip-path or mask-image), scrubbed.

name: Torn reveal per image
prompt: Each image tears open from the middle with a rough edge when it enters. SVG mask, no WebGL; use on every image of a case study.

name: Media travels between zones
prompt: One media element moves and resizes into a different container at each scroll step. Product storytelling.

name: Pile to grid
prompt: Cards start in a rotated pile and fly to their grid positions on scroll.

name: Scatter cluster
prompt: A pile of photo and stat cards in the centre scatters to its places as you scroll, uncovering the headline; reverses on scroll back.

name: Velocity clip
prompt: Clip-path inset grows with scroll speed and direction, then relaxes. Kinetic editorial headers.

name: SVG line draw
prompt: Stroke draws from 0 to 100 % through the section. For line illustrations and connectors.

name: Grid parallax modes
prompt: Columns of an image grid move at different speeds: elastic, wave, centre pull. Needs smooth scrolling; keep it off on touch.

name: Grid chapters
prompt: Three chapters on a visible grid; pinned centre text swaps line by line while images drift at their own speeds.

name: Step wipe
prompt: Tall section where background and centre card clip open together for each product step; title, number and text swap in sync.

name: Horizontal case study
prompt: Vertical scroll drives a sideways strip: intro, images of different sizes, note, quote; each panel reveals once. Stacks into a column on phones.

name: Pinned process list
prompt: Steps come forward one at a time while a thin line grows to each and the image beside it changes. Click a step to jump.

name: Process rail with bead
prompt: A bead travels along a line drawing it, each step lights up when reached and its image fades in.

name: Orb process
prompt: Ring of step names around a glossy orb; the ring turns each step to the top and the orb shifts to that step's colours.

name: Sticky chapter rail
prompt: Chapter names pinned on the left with scroll-spy; a hairline indicator slides and resizes to the active one.

name: Timeline dial
prompt: Months or years around a large dial with ticks; scroll clicks it round one step with an elastic landing. Year in review, company history.

name: Rising stat cards
prompt: Stat cards rise and straighten into a grid, numbers roll like an odometer when each card arrives.

name: Counter
prompt: Rolling digits per column or a simple count-up with prefix and suffix; tabular figures.

name: Logo wall shuffle
prompt: Client logos in a hairline grid swap one cell at a time while the section is pinned; arrows step a full set.

name: Image dissolve
prompt: Noise shader dissolves one image into the next with scroll progress.

name: Torn paper transition
prompt: The first image tears away bottom up to paper, the paper tears onto the next image.

name: Fog transition
prompt: A fog bank rolls up and swallows one scene, then clears onto another; headline fades in the fog too.

name: Bending image field
prompt: Photos at different depths bend like fabric with scroll speed and flatten when still.

name: Images fly toward viewer
prompt: Images move from deep in the page toward the viewer around a clear centre for content; drifts with the cursor.

name: Draggable marquee
prompt: Endless row with autoplay that can be dragged and snaps to the centre item; pause on hover and focus; static under reduced motion.

name: Parallax slider
prompt: Looping slides with inner layers at different speeds; autoplay pauses on hover.

name: Infinite drag grid
prompt: Grid you drag in any direction with momentum and seamless wrap. Portfolios and galleries.

name: Wipe slider
prompt: Full-screen hero slides; each change wipes the background from the travel direction while copy masks out and in.

name: Curtain slider
prompt: The outgoing image splits into columns that wipe away one after another; arrows, drag and keys.

name: Scale slider
prompt: Square photos shrink toward one edge, the largest cropped by the screen; drag, throw or scroll.

name: Lens rail
prompt: Strip of photos dragged sideways; the one passing the centre grows like under a magnifier.

name: Expanding strip
prompt: Tall panels edge to edge; the hovered one widens and its title rises, the others compress.

name: Card fan
prompt: A stack of cards fans into an arc on hover; the card under the pointer lifts forward.

name: Photo stack
prompt: A stack unfolds into a strip and a featured image on click; clicking a thumbnail swaps the feature.

name: Diagonal gallery
prompt: Photos queue on a diagonal; each scroll step moves the current one to a thumbnail top-left and grows the next into the centre.

name: Radial ring
prompt: A slowly turning ring of cards sized to fit the screen; behind a hero or CTA.

name: Spiral gallery
prompt: Cards on an endless vertical helix; drag to spin with momentum.

name: Drifting card deck
prompt: WebGL deck fanned on a diagonal that drifts; cards part around the cursor and the hovered one updates a detail panel.

name: Project wheel
prompt: Project titles on the edge of a large wheel; the one at the centre lights up and swaps the image beside it.

name: Portrait ring
prompt: Greyscale portraits around a ring; scroll turns the next one into the top slot in colour with its name.

name: Bento focus
prompt: Bento grid with one large slot; clicking a small tile grows it into the slot and reflows the others.

name: Animated filter grid
prompt: Category filter and grid/list toggle where cards fly to new places instead of jumping.

name: Category swap portraits
prompt: Centred category list with portrait cards around it; choosing a category swaps all photos with a lift and blur.

name: Team slider with filters
prompt: Group chips filter a horizontal card slider; clicking a person opens a short profile over the photo.

name: Testimonial sphere
prompt: Draggable sphere of image planes behind frosted testimonial cards; off on phones.

name: Locations globe
prompt: Dotted globe you can drag; selecting a location turns it to face, shows the label and draws routes.

name: Circular slider
prompt: Value input dragged around a circle with an arc that fills; keyboard arrows must work.

name: Header folds into a pill
prompt: Wide header over the hero that shrinks into a floating pill after the first scroll and opens again at the top.

name: Pill to menu panel
prompt: A small Menu pill grows into the whole navigation panel; links cascade in and roll on hover.

name: Section island
prompt: A capsule at the top names the current section; click grows it into the section list and a short preview.

name: Page turns into menu
prompt: The page slides, rotates and scales away while the menu overlay slides in; burger morphs to X; image per link.

name: Two-panel drawer
prompt: Drawer reveals with clip-path; hovering a category opens a second panel beside it; drill-down on mobile.

name: Morphing mega menu
prompt: One dropdown container that changes height between groups, content enters from the side you came from, with hover intent.

name: Gooey action menu
prompt: A floating button that fans out actions joined by a gooey filter; arc, line, grid or radial.

name: Footer with dock
prompt: Footer uncovered with parallax, columns rise through masks, a glass pill morphs into quick navigation.

name: Glow footer
prompt: Footer with a soft glow from the bottom edge and a wordmark sized to the full width; links with a slide underline.

name: Proximity index
prompt: List of projects whose brightness falls off with distance from the pointer; a preview card wipes to the hovered project.

name: Index wipe
prompt: Full-screen list where hovering a name wipes its photo into the background from the pointer direction.

name: Liquid list hover
prompt: Rows fill with a curved shape from the side the pointer enters.

name: List with following image
prompt: Hovering a row shows its image near the pointer, eased; desktop only.

name: Magnetic button
prompt: Button and its label follow the pointer with different strength. Primary action only.

name: Circle fill from pointer
prompt: Fill grows from where the pointer enters, timed so it always takes the same duration.

name: Curved fill from direction
prompt: A wave-shaped fill enters from the pointer side and leaves the same way.

name: Slide-up fill
prompt: Fill slides up from the bottom with optional scale; label colour switches for contrast.

name: Icon morph button
prompt: Icon rotates or morphs and the button fills on hover.

name: Jelly button
prompt: Squashes on press and wobbles back from the side the pointer came from. Playful brands.

name: Gradient flow button
prompt: A multi-colour gradient flows across on hover. Playful brands, one per page.

name: Accordion
prompt: Animated height with the answer's lines rising through masks; single or multiple open.

name: Liquid accordion
prompt: The answer pours out of the question pill and settles into a panel.

name: Tabs joined to content
prompt: The active tab pill is joined to the panel by a curved neck that follows it.

name: Morphing dialog
prompt: Trigger card grows into the dialog with shared elements; others fade in. Focus trap and Escape.

name: Rising dialog
prompt: Preview tile opens a tall dialog; page dims and blurs behind.

name: Push drawer
prompt: Hero click slides in a detail panel while the hero moves away and darkens; reverse on close.

name: List row to panel
prompt: Clicking a row grows it into a detail panel with its thumbnail and title travelling into place.

name: Liquid select
prompt: Dropdown separates from the trigger with a gooey neck; chosen value rolls into place.

name: Shared tooltip
prompt: One tooltip slides between toolbar buttons and resizes to each caption.

name: Smart tooltip
prompt: Tooltip anchored or following the pointer that flips at viewport edges.

name: Liquid toasts
prompt: Toasts stack with a stretching neck between them; hover fans the stack.

name: Gooey filter chips
prompt: Chosen chips fly into a tray and merge with a gooey neck; result count rolls.

name: Rolling quantity stepper
prompt: Plus and minus roll the digits up or down; holding repeats faster.

name: Multi-step form
prompt: Steps slide in the travel direction, labels float, the send button morphs to a loading dot then a tick.

name: Pricing toggle
prompt: Monthly/yearly switch rolls every price digit by digit and pops a savings chip.

name: Video player with fullscreen grow
prompt: Custom controls; fullscreen grows from its place and returns without stopping the video.

name: Cursor with labels
prompt: Eased cursor dot with a label on hover targets; off on touch and reduced motion.

name: Image trail
prompt: Images spawn along the pointer path and shrink away. Portfolios only.

name: Tilt card
prompt: Card tilts toward the pointer with glare and shadow; small angle.

name: Elastic divider
prompt: A section line springs and rings when the pointer sweeps across it.

name: Magnetic tag cloud
prompt: Tags knocked away by fast pointer moves and pulled back home.

name: Random rotation reveal
prompt: Grid items reveal with a small random angle for a loose, handmade layout.

name: Mesh gradient
prompt: Up to eight colour anchors orbit and blend; the pointer stirs them. Hero background; colours from the palette.

name: Ink bloom
prompt: A single wash of brand colour hangs from the top edge and reaches for the cursor.

name: Dither filter
prompt: Images or video rendered as two-colour ordered dither with a lens that shows the real colours under the pointer.

name: Dither cursor trail
prompt: A fading trail behind the pointer drawn in dither dots; no image needed.

name: ASCII image
prompt: Picture redrawn as characters by brightness, typing itself in.

name: ASCII overlay
prompt: Characters bloom over the bright parts of a photo or video with scroll; the photo stays.

name: CRT glitch
prompt: Image behind curved CRT glass that breaks into static on hover and locks back.

name: Gooey paint reveal
prompt: Pointer paints gooey blobs that cut through a cover to the content below.
